// TP3-CC1-COLLECT: collect one already-started read-only checker; never dispatch a phase.
function cc1Utf8Bytes(value) {
  let bytes = 0;
  for (const character of value) {
    const point = character.codePointAt(0);
    bytes += point <= 0x7f ? 1 : point <= 0x7ff ? 2 : point <= 0xffff ? 3 : 4;
  }
  return bytes;
}
async function finishCc1Readback(first, expected, deadline, io) {
  const state = { status: "COLLECTING", chunks: [], pendingSession: null, output: "" };
  const save = () => io.retain(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state)));
  let result = first;
  let session;
  try {
    for (;;) {
      state.chunks.push(result);
      if (state.pendingSession === null && result && Number.isInteger(result.session_id) && result.session_id > 0) {
        state.pendingSession = result.session_id;
      }
      save(); // Preserve the raw result before any validation can throw.
      if (!Number.isFinite(deadline)) throw new Error("CC1 invalid readback deadline");
      if (!result || typeof result.output !== "string") throw new Error("CC1 invalid tool result");
      state.output += result.output;
      if (cc1Utf8Bytes(state.output) > 1048576) throw new Error("CC1 readback output cap");
      if (io.now() > deadline) throw new Error("CC1 readback deadline");
      if (result.session_id === undefined) {
        const completed = { ...result, output: state.output };
        const receipt = acceptRh1Check(completed, expected);
        state.status = "PASS"; state.pendingSession = null; save();
        return receipt;
      }
      if (!Number.isInteger(result.session_id) || result.session_id <= 0 ||
          result.exit_code !== undefined ||
          (session !== undefined && result.session_id !== session)) {
        throw new Error("CC1 pending identity rejected");
      }
      session = result.session_id;
      state.pendingSession = session;
      const remaining = deadline - io.now();
      if (remaining <= 0) throw new Error("CC1 readback deadline");
      result = await io.wait({ session_id: session, chars: "", yield_time_ms: Math.min(10000, remaining), max_output_tokens: 5000 });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    state.status = "REJECTED"; state.error = String(error); save();
    throw error;
  }
}
// Complete calling pattern for one approved read-only checker; use the frozen body unchanged.
// Bind cc1ReadOnlyCheck, cc1Expected and cc1Deadline from the current accepted attempt.
// cc1Deadline is the existing phase/global cutoff, never a newly extended clock.
async function checkCc1Readback(cc1ReadOnlyCheck, cc1Expected, cc1Deadline, tools, retain) {
  let first;
  try {
    if (!Number.isFinite(cc1Deadline) || cc1Deadline <= Date.now()) throw new Error("CC1 invalid readback deadline");
    first = await tools.exec_command(cc1ReadOnlyCheck);
    retain({ status: "INITIAL_RESULT", chunks: [first], pendingSession: first?.session_id ?? null });
  } catch (error) {
    retain({ status: "START_FAILED", error: String(error), chunks: [] });
    throw error;
  }
  return finishCc1Readback(first, cc1Expected, cc1Deadline, {
    now: () => Date.now(),
    wait: args => tools.write_stdin(args),
    retain
  });
}
// Actual orchestration calls only this read-only boundary and saves every state with
// value => store("m202-cc1-current-readback", value), before inspecting its returned PASS.
// No next-phase tool call belongs in this block. On failure stop and reconcile the
// retained checker session/owned identities through the existing stop procedure.

// TP3-CC1-COLLECT-TEST: inject the unchanged RH1 predicate and complete CC1 collector.
async function testCc1Collector(api) {
  const results = [];
  const expected = { Phase: "test", Root: "fresh-root" };
  const json = JSON.stringify({ Status: "PASS", ...expected });
  const completed = output => ({ exit_code: 0, output });
  async function run(name, chunks, reject, options = {}) {
    const retained = [], waits = []; let clock = 0;
    const io = {
      retain: value => retained.push(value),
      now: () => clock,
      wait: async args => {
        waits.push(args);
        if (options.advance) clock = options.advance;
        if (options.throwWait) throw Error("injected wait failure");
        if (!chunks.length) throw Error("unexpected extra poll");
        return chunks.shift();
      }
    };
    let error, receipt;
    try { receipt = await api.finish(chunks.shift(), expected, options.deadline ?? 25000, io); }
    catch (caught) { error = String(caught); }
    if (Boolean(error) !== reject) throw Error(name + ": wrong verdict " + error);
    if (reject && options.error && !error.includes(options.error)) throw Error(name + ": wrong rejection " + error);
    const last = retained.at(-1);
    if (!last || last.status !== (reject ? "REJECTED" : "PASS") || !last.chunks.length) throw Error(name + ": raw result lost");
    if (!reject && (receipt.Root !== expected.Root || last.output !== json || last.pendingSession !== null)) throw Error(name + ": receipt drift");
    if (options.pending !== undefined && last.pendingSession !== options.pending) throw Error(name + ": pending identity lost");
    if (options.chunkCount !== undefined && last.chunks.length !== options.chunkCount) throw Error(name + ": chunks lost");
    if (waits.some(args => args.session_id !== 71 || args.chars !== "" || args.yield_time_ms <= 0 || args.yield_time_ms > 10000)) throw Error(name + ": poll contract");
    results.push({ Case: name, Rejected: reject, Waits: waits.length, Chunks: last.chunks.length });
  }
  await run("immediate", [completed(json)], false);
  await run("split-json", [{session_id:71,output:json.slice(0,5)}, {session_id:71,output:json.slice(5,20)}, completed(json.slice(20))], false, {chunkCount:3});
  await run("empty-pending", [{session_id:71,output:""}, completed(json)], false);
  await run("nonzero", [{exit_code:2,output:json}], true);
  await run("malformed-json", [completed("{")], true);
  await run("wrong-status", [completed('{"Status":"FAIL","Phase":"test","Root":"fresh-root"}')], true);
  await run("wrong-root", [completed('{"Status":"PASS","Phase":"test","Root":"old-root"}')], true);
  await run("missing-phase", [completed('{"Status":"PASS","Root":"fresh-root"}')], true);
  await run("null-handle", [{session_id:null,output:json}], true);
  await run("string-handle", [{session_id:"71",output:json}], true);
  await run("changed-handle", [{session_id:71,output:"a"},{session_id:72,output:"b"}], true, {pending:71,chunkCount:2});
  await run("pending-with-exit", [{session_id:71,exit_code:0,output:json}], true, {pending:71});
  await run("missing-exit", [{output:json}], true);
  await run("missing-output", [{exit_code:0}], true);
  await run("null-result", [null], true);
  await run("wait-throws", [{session_id:71,output:"raw-before-error"}], true, {throwWait:true,pending:71,error:"injected wait failure"});
  await run("invalid-deadline", [completed(json)], true, {deadline:NaN});
  await run("expired-before-poll", [{session_id:71,output:"raw"}], true, {deadline:-1,pending:71});
  await run("deadline-after-wait", [{session_id:71,output:""},completed(json)], true, {advance:26000,pending:71,chunkCount:2});
  await run("ascii-cap", [completed("x".repeat(1048577))], true, {error:"output cap"});
  await run("utf8-cap", [completed("é".repeat(524289))], true, {error:"output cap"});
  await run("aggregate-cap", [{session_id:71,output:"a".repeat(600000)}, completed("b".repeat(600000))], true, {pending:71,chunkCount:2,error:"output cap"});
  if (api.bytes("aé€😀\ud800") !== 13) throw Error("UTF-8 width test");
  results.push({Case:"utf8-widths",Rejected:false});
  for (const name of ["start-immediate","start-pending","start-throws","start-expired","start-nonzero"]) {
    const retained=[]; let starts=0, polls=0, error, receipt;
    const fakeTools={
      exec_command: async command => {
        starts++; if(command.cmd!=="approved-read-only") throw Error("wrong command");
        if(name==="start-throws") throw Error("injected start failure");
        if(name==="start-nonzero") return {exit_code:2,output:"raw-start-failure"};
        return name==="start-pending" ? {session_id:71,output:""} : completed(json);

    try { receipt=await api.check({cmd:"approved-read-only"},expected,Date.now()+(name==="start-expired"?-1:25000),fakeTools,value=>retained.push(value)); }
    catch(caught){error=String(caught);}
    if(Boolean(error)!==reject || starts!==(name==="start-expired"?0:1) || polls!==(name==="start-pending"?1:0))throw Error(name+": dispatch count");
    if(!reject && receipt.Root!==expected.Root)throw Error(name+": receipt");
    if(!retained.length || (!["start-expired","start-throws"].includes(name) && retained[0].status!=="INITIAL_RESULT"))throw Error(name+": initial result lost");
    if(name==="start-nonzero" && retained.at(-1).chunks[0].output!=="raw-start-failure")throw Error(name+": raw failure lost");
    results.push({Case:name,Rejected:reject,Starts:starts,Polls:polls});
  }
  return {Status:"PASS",Count:results.length,Cases:results,RealEffects:"None; actual V8 engine, synthetic tool boundaries; no phase dispatcher exists"};
}

**Actual binary/link field reader.**

```powershell
# TP3-EXEC13-BINARY-FIELDS: read-only actual generated edge, PE report and output boundary.
function Get-X13BinaryFields([string]$Root) {
 $build=Join-Path $Root 'build'
 $binary=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $build 'bin/llama-tokenize.exe'))
 Assert-TpOrdinary $binary
 $binItems=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $build 'bin') -Recurse -Force)
 if($binItems.Count-ne 1-or $binItems[0].FullName-cne $binary){throw 'EXEC13 unexpected binary payload'}
 $all=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $build -Recurse -Force)
 foreach($item in $all){Assert-TpOrdinary $item.FullName}
 if(@($all|Where-Object{-not $_.PSIsContainer-and $_.Extension-ieq '.dll'}).Count){throw 'EXEC13 runtime DLL'}
 $edgeMatches=[regex]::Matches([IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $build 'build.ninja')),'(?m)^build bin/llama-tokenize\.exe: ([^\r\n]+)\r?\n(?:  [^\r\n]*\r?\n)*')
 if($edgeMatches.Count-ne 1){throw 'EXEC13 tokenizer edge count'}
 $edge=$edgeMatches[0].Value
 if($edge-notmatch '(?m)^  LINK_FLAGS = -static\r?$'){throw 'EXEC13 final static link missing'}
 $rule=$edgeMatches[0].Groups[1].Value.Split(' ')[0]
 $rules=[IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $build 'CMakeFiles/rules.ninja'))
 $ruleMatches=[regex]::Matches($rules,'(?m)^rule '+[regex]::Escape($rule)+'\r?\n(?:  [^\r\n]*\r?\n)*')
 if($ruleMatches.Count-ne 1-or -not $ruleMatches[0].Value.Contains('$LINK_FLAGS')){throw 'EXEC13 effective link rule'}
 $report=Join-Path $Root 'receipts/readobj.stdout'
 $errorLog=Join-Path $Root 'receipts/readobj.stderr'
 Assert-TpOrdinary $report;Assert-TpOrdinary $errorLog
 if((Get-Item -LiteralPath $report).Length-gt 1MB-or (Get-Item -LiteralPath $errorLog).Length-ne 0){throw 'EXEC13 PE report bounds'}
 $text=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($report)
 if($text-notmatch '(?m)^Format: COFF-x86-64\r?$'-or $text-notmatch 'Machine: IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64 \(0x8664\)'){throw 'EXEC13 PE architecture'}
 $imports=@([regex]::Matches($text,'(?m)^  Name: ([^\r\n]+)\r?$')|ForEach-Object{$_.Groups[1].Value})
 if($imports.Count-eq 0-or @([regex]::Matches($text,'(?m)^Import \{\r?$')).Count-ne $imports.Count){throw 'EXEC13 incomplete imports'}
 foreach($name in $imports){
  if($name-notmatch '^(KERNEL32|SHELL32|ADVAPI32|WS2_32|USER32|GDI32|OLE32|OLEAUT32|COMDLG32|WINMM|BCRYPT|NTDLL|UCRTBASE|api-ms-win-crt-[a-z0-9-]+)\.dll$'){throw ('EXEC13 non-system import: '+$name)}
 }
 $rows=@($all|Where-Object{-not $_.PSIsContainer}|ForEach-Object{
  [pscustomobject]@{Path=[IO.Path]::GetRelativePath($build,$_.FullName).Replace('\','/');Bytes=$_.Length;Sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_.FullName).Hash}
 })
 foreach($row in $rows|Where-Object{$_.Path-match '\.exe$'}){
  if($row.Path-cne 'bin/llama-tokenize.exe'-and $row.Path-notmatch '^CMakeFiles/(4\.4\.3/CompilerId(C|CXX)/|CMakeScratch/)'){throw 'EXEC13 unexpected build executable'}
 }
 [pscustomobject]@{BinaryBytes=(Get-Item -LiteralPath $binary).Length;BinarySha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $binary).Hash;Imports=$imports;LinkEdge=$edge;LinkRule=$ruleMatches[0].Value;BuildFiles=$rows;ReadobjSha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $report).Hash}
}

# TP3-RH1-READBACK: read only; parameters are machine-bound, never transcribed PTY hashes.
function Assert-Rh1Receipt([string]$Root,[object]$Row) {
 if($Row.Name -cnotin @('admission.json','prerequisite-versions.json')-or $Row.Sha256 -cnotmatch '^[0-9A-F]{64}$'-or $Row.Bytes -isnot [long]-and $Row.Bytes -isnot [int]-or $Row.Bytes-lt 1-or $Row.Bytes-gt 1MB){throw 'RH1 invalid identity'}
 $path=Join-Path $Root ('receipts/'+$Row.Name)
 $file=Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force
 if($file.PSIsContainer-or ($file.Attributes-band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)-or $file.Length-ne $Row.Bytes-or (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $path).Hash-cne $Row.Sha256){throw 'RH1 receipt mismatch'}
}
function Assert-Rh1Admission([string]$Root,[object]$Identity,[int]$ExpectedPid,[string]$ExpectedStart,[string]$Execution) {
 if($Identity.Status-cne 'PASS'-or $Identity.Phase-cne 'admission'-or $Identity.Execution-cne $Execution-or $Identity.Root-cne $Root-or $Identity.Pid-ne $ExpectedPid-or $Identity.ProcessStart-cne $ExpectedStart){throw 'RH1 producer identity'}
 if(@($Identity.Receipts).Count-ne 2){throw 'RH1 receipt set'}
 foreach($name in @('admission.json','prerequisite-versions.json')){
  if(@($Identity.Receipts|Where-Object{$_.Name-ceq $name}).Count-ne 1){throw 'RH1 receipt name set'}
 }
 foreach($row in $Identity.Receipts){Assert-Rh1Receipt $Root $row}
 $admission=[IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $Root 'receipts/admission.json'))|ConvertFrom-Json
 $versions=@([IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $Root 'receipts/prerequisite-versions.json'))|ConvertFrom-Json)
 if($admission.Execution-cne $Execution-or $admission.Pid-ne $ExpectedPid-or $admission.ProcessStart.ToUniversalTime().ToString('O')-cne $ExpectedStart-or $admission.InputIdentities-cne 'MATCH'-or $admission.OriginalInputs-ne 12-or $admission.RetainedDownloads-ne 9-or @($admission.EnvironmentNames).Count-ne 36-or @($admission.Essentials).Count-ne 17-or @($admission.Settings).Count-ne 19-or $versions.Count-ne 6){throw 'RH1 admission semantics'}
 foreach($name in @('python','node','uv','git','npm','curl')){
  $rows=@($versions|Where-Object{$_.Name-ceq $name})
  if($rows.Count-ne 1-or $rows[0].ExitCode-ne 0){throw 'RH1 version set'}
  foreach($stream in @('stdout','stderr')){
   $file=Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Root ('receipts/version-'+$name+'.'+$stream)) -Force
   $expected=$rows[0].($stream.Substring(0,1).ToUpperInvariant()+$stream.Substring(1)+'Sha256')
   if($file.PSIsContainer-or ($file.Attributes-band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)-or $file.Length-gt 1MB-or $expected-cnotmatch '^[0-9A-F]{64}$'-or (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $file.FullName).Hash-cne $expected){throw 'RH1 version log'}
  }
 }
 [pscustomobject]@{Status='PASS';Phase='admission';Root=$Root;Pid=$ExpectedPid;ProcessStart=$ExpectedStart;Receipts=2;Versions=6}
}
# Actual caller: supply rh1Root/rh1Pid/rh1Start from the new attempt's machine-read binding.
$rh1IdentityPath=Join-Path $rh1Root 'receipts/admission-identity.json'
$rh1IdentityFile=Get-Item -LiteralPath $rh1IdentityPath -Force
if($rh1IdentityFile.PSIsContainer-or ($rh1IdentityFile.Attributes-band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)-or $rh1IdentityFile.Length-gt 1MB){throw 'RH1 identity file'}
$rh1ReadIdentity=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($rh1IdentityPath)|ConvertFrom-Json -DateKind String
Assert-Rh1Admission $rh1Root $rh1ReadIdentity $rh1Pid $rh1Start 'M202-TOOLING-EXEC-11'|ConvertTo-Json -Compress

// TP3-RH1-ACCEPT: normal non-PTY checker result only; never accept a running session.
function acceptRh1Check(result, expected) {
  if (!result || result.exit_code !== 0 || result.session_id !== undefined ||
      typeof result.output !== "string" || result.output.length > 1048576) {
    throw new Error("RH1 checker did not complete successfully");
  }
  const receipt = JSON.parse(result.output);
  if (!receipt || Array.isArray(receipt) || receipt.Status !== "PASS" ||
      Object.entries(expected).some(([key, value]) => receipt[key] !== value)) {
    throw new Error("RH1 checker receipt rejected");
  }
  return receipt;
}

```javascript
// TP3-RH1-TEST: stub dispatch only; no external commands or phases.
async function testRh1Dispatch() {
  const expected = {Phase:"admission",Root:"test-root",Pid:123,ProcessStart:"test-start",Receipts:2,Versions:6};
  const pass = {Status:"PASS",...expected};
  const good = () => ({exit_code:0,output:JSON.stringify(pass)});
  const cases = [
    ["valid",good,true],
    ["nonzero",()=>({...good(),exit_code:1}),false],
    ["missing-exit",()=>({output:JSON.stringify(pass)}),false],
    ["pending",()=>({...good(),session_id:10}),false],
    ["throw",()=>{throw new Error("tool failure");},false],
    ["absent",()=>undefined,false],
    ["empty-output",()=>({...good(),output:""}),false],
    ["malformed",()=>({...good(),output:"not JSON"}),false],
    ["multiple-objects",()=>({...good(),output:JSON.stringify(pass)+JSON.stringify(pass)}),false],
    ["missing-pass",()=>({...good(),output:JSON.stringify(expected)}),false],
    ["failed-status",()=>({...good(),output:JSON.stringify({...pass,Status:"FAIL"})}),false],
    ["wrong-phase",()=>({...good(),output:JSON.stringify({...pass,Phase:"copy"})}),false],
    ["wrong-root",()=>({...good(),output:JSON.stringify({...pass,Root:"stale-root"})}),false],
    ["wrong-host",()=>({...good(),output:JSON.stringify({...pass,Pid:124})}),false],
    ["wrong-start",()=>({...good(),output:JSON.stringify({...pass,ProcessStart:"stale-start"})}),false],
    ["wrong-count",()=>({...good(),output:JSON.stringify({...pass,Versions:5})}),false]
  ];
  const results=[];
  for (const [name,check,shouldDispatch] of cases) {
    let dispatches=0, rejected=false;
    try {
      const checked=await check();
      const accepted=acceptRh1Check(checked,expected);
      await (()=>{dispatches++;})();
    } catch { rejected=true; }
    if(dispatches!==(shouldDispatch?1:0)||rejected===shouldDispatch)throw new Error("RH1 case failed: "+name);
    results.push({Name:name,Dispatches:dispatches,Rejected:rejected});
  }
  return {Status:"PASS",Cases:results};
}

# TP3-SC1-DERIVE: in-memory correction only; does not invoke inventory or copy.
$sc1Plan = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path (Get-Location) 'docs/plans/m2-02-embedding-retrieval-capacity-gate.md')).Replace([string][char]13,'')
$sc1Fences = [regex]::Matches($sc1Plan,'(?ms)^' + [char]96 + '{3}powershell\n(.*?)^' + [char]96 + '{3}\s*$')
function Get-Sc1Fence([string]$Marker) {
    $matches = @($sc1Fences | Where-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value.StartsWith($Marker) })
    if ($matches.Count -ne 1) { throw 'SC1 fence count' }
    $matches[0].Groups[1].Value
}
function Get-Sc1Hash([string]$Text) {
    [Convert]::ToHexString([Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::HashData([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($Text)))
}
$sc1Original = Get-Sc1Fence '# TP3-LINK1-INVENTORY:'
if ((Get-Sc1Hash $sc1Original) -cne '7E0004F189E0E325572E4CC4C77DB199E56A23A4F87803C8B3F34FF2AFFB6418') { throw 'SC1 original pin' }

if ([regex]::Matches($sc1Original,[regex]::Escape($sc1OldLine)).Count -ne 1) { throw 'SC1 replacement count' }
$sc1Corrected = $sc1Original.Replace($sc1OldLine,$sc1NewLine)
if ($sc1Corrected.Replace($sc1NewLine,$sc1OldLine) -cne $sc1Original) { throw 'SC1 reverse mismatch' }

$sc1Ast = [Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseInput($sc1Corrected,[ref]$sc1Tokens,[ref]$sc1Errors)
if ($sc1Errors.Count) { throw 'SC1 corrected syntax' }

```powershell
# TP3-LINK1-COPY: bounded verified tree copy; definitions only.
function Copy-Lk1Tree([string]$SourceRoot, [string]$DestinationRoot, [object[]]$Rows) {
    if ([DateTime]::UtcNow -gt $tpPhaseDeadline -or [DateTime]::UtcNow -gt $tpEnd) { throw 'LK1 copy deadline' }
    Assert-TpOrdinary $SourceRoot
    Assert-TpOrdinary $DestinationRoot $false
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $DestinationRoot) { throw 'LK1 existing destination' }
    if (-not $Rows.Count -or @($Rows.Path | Sort-Object -Unique).Count -ne $Rows.Count) { throw 'LK1 invalid inventory' }
    $sourceBase = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($SourceRoot).TrimEnd('\','/') + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar
    $destBase = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($DestinationRoot).TrimEnd('\','/') + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar
    if ($destBase.StartsWith($sourceBase,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or
        $sourceBase.StartsWith($destBase,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'LK1 overlapping roots' }
    foreach ($row in $Rows) {
        if ([IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($row.Path) -or $row.Path.Contains('\') -or
            $row.Path.Split('/') -contains '..' -or $row.Path.Split('/') -contains '.' -or
            $row.Path.Split('/') -contains '' -or $row.Path -match '[:*?"<>|\x00-\x1f]' -or
            $row.Bytes -lt 0 -or $row.Sha256 -notmatch '^[A-Fa-f0-9]{64}$') { throw 'LK1 unsafe row' }
        $src = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $SourceRoot $row.Path))
        $dst = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $DestinationRoot $row.Path))
        if (-not $src.StartsWith($sourceBase,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or
            -not $dst.StartsWith($destBase,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'LK1 escaped path' }
    }
    $actual = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $SourceRoot -Recurse -Force -File)
    foreach ($item in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $SourceRoot -Recurse -Force)) {
        if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw 'LK1 source reparse' }
    }
    $actualPaths = @($actual | ForEach-Object { [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath($SourceRoot,$_.FullName).Replace('\','/') })
    if ($actualPaths.Count -ne $Rows.Count -or (Compare-Object $actualPaths $Rows.Path -CaseSensitive)) { throw 'LK1 incomplete inventory' }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $DestinationRoot | Out-Null
    foreach ($row in $Rows) {
        if ([DateTime]::UtcNow -gt $tpPhaseDeadline -or [DateTime]::UtcNow -gt $tpEnd) { throw 'LK1 copy deadline' }
        $src = Join-Path $SourceRoot $row.Path
        $dst = Join-Path $DestinationRoot $row.Path
        Assert-TpOrdinary $src
        Assert-TpOrdinary $dst $false
        $parent = Split-Path $dst
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null }
        $inputStream = [IO.File]::Open($src,[IO.FileMode]::Open,[IO.FileAccess]::Read,[IO.FileShare]::Read)
        try {
            if ($inputStream.Length -ne $row.Bytes -or
                [Convert]::ToHexString([Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::HashData($inputStream)) -cne $row.Sha256.ToUpperInvariant()) { throw 'LK1 source identity' }
            $inputStream.Position = 0
            $outputStream = [IO.File]::Open($dst,[IO.FileMode]::CreateNew,[IO.FileAccess]::ReadWrite,[IO.FileShare]::None)
            try {
                $inputStream.CopyTo($outputStream)
                $outputStream.Flush()
                $outputStream.Position = 0
                if ($outputStream.Length -ne $row.Bytes -or
                    [Convert]::ToHexString([Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::HashData($outputStream)) -cne $row.Sha256.ToUpperInvariant()) { throw 'LK1 destination identity' }
            } finally { $outputStream.Dispose() }
        } finally { $inputStream.Dispose() }
    }
    $copied = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $DestinationRoot -Recurse -Force -File)
    $copiedPaths = @($copied | ForEach-Object { [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath($DestinationRoot,$_.FullName).Replace('\','/') })
    if ($copied.Count -ne $Rows.Count -or (Compare-Object $copiedPaths $Rows.Path -CaseSensitive)) { throw 'LK1 copied inventory' }
    foreach ($item in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $DestinationRoot -Recurse -Force)) {
        if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw 'LK1 destination reparse' }
    }
    if ([DateTime]::UtcNow -gt $tpPhaseDeadline -or [DateTime]::UtcNow -gt $tpEnd) { throw 'LK1 copy deadline' }
    [pscustomobject]@{Files=$Rows.Count;Bytes=($Rows | Measure-Object Bytes -Sum).Sum;Status='MATCH'}
}
```

function Assert-Lk1Tree([string]$Base,[object[]]$Rows,[bool]$CheckBytes=$true) {
    Assert-TpOrdinary $Base

    if (-not $CheckBytes) { return }

        Assert-TpHash (Join-Path $Base $row.Path) $row.Bytes $row.Sha256
    }
}

downloads/pyyaml-6.0.3-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl|154003|5FCD34E47F6E0B794D17DE1B4FF496C00986E1C83F7AB2FB8FCFE9616FF7477B

schema/sentencepiece_model.proto|14023|798FB346A2934CC58A0F905BE120F6710D0585847EDF5425B7A1CF68102979BC
schema/sentencepiece_model_pb2.py|6257|2DAC04C267548885354FD1DC62EFAB34455315CC0087D8BEA9ABCC32C83DAE21

function Assert-Ru1File([string]$Base, $Row) {
    $path=Join-Path $Base $Row.Path
    Assert-TpHash $path $Row.Bytes $Row.Sha256
    if ($Row.Path -eq 'downloads/tokenizers-0.1.3.tgz') {
        $sri='sha512-' + [Convert]::ToBase64String([Security.Cryptography.SHA512]::HashData([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($path)))
        if ($sri -cne 'sha512-8rF/RRT10u+kn7YuUbUg0OF30K8rjTc78aHpxT+qJ1uWSqxT1MHi8+9ltwYfkFYJzT/oS+qw3JVfHtNMGAdqyA==') { throw 'RU1 SRI identity' }
    }
    if ($Row.Path.StartsWith('schema/',[StringComparison]::Ordinal)) {
        $expected=if ($Row.Path -eq 'schema/sentencepiece_model.proto') {'7c3e3f54d688ff9bc33ac1897290ef58ff4549f3'} else {'b07107d69de178e107544a29bb4d0280b5482241'}
        $bytes=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($path)
        $header=[Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes('blob ' + $bytes.Length + [char]0)
        $blob=[Convert]::ToHexString([Security.Cryptography.SHA1]::HashData([byte[]]($header+$bytes))).ToLowerInvariant()
        if ($blob -cne $expected) { throw 'RU1 Git blob identity' }
    }
}
function Copy-Ru1Downloads {
    if ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ruSource).TrimEnd('\','/') -eq [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($tpRoot).TrimEnd('\','/')) { throw 'RU1 identical roots' }
    foreach ($base in $ruSource,$tpRoot) { Assert-TpOrdinary $base }
    foreach ($name in 'downloads','schema','receipts') {
        $directory=Join-Path $tpRoot $name
        Assert-TpOrdinary $directory
        if (-not (Get-Item -LiteralPath $directory -Force).PSIsContainer) { throw 'RU1 destination directory' }
    }
    $receipt=Join-Path $tpRoot 'receipts/reuse.json'
    Assert-TpOrdinary $receipt $false
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $receipt) { throw 'RU1 existing receipt' }
    foreach ($row in $ruFiles) {
        Assert-Ru1File $ruSource $row
        $destination=Join-Path $tpRoot $row.Path
        Assert-TpOrdinary $destination $false
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $destination) { throw 'RU1 existing destination' }
    }
    foreach ($name in 'downloads','schema') {
        if (@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $tpRoot $name) -Force).Count) { throw 'RU1 nonempty destination' }
    }
    foreach ($row in $ruFiles) {
        Assert-Ru1File $ruSource $row
        $destination=Join-Path $tpRoot $row.Path
        Assert-TpOrdinary $destination $false
        [IO.File]::Copy((Join-Path $ruSource $row.Path),$destination,$false)
        Assert-Ru1File $tpRoot $row
    }
    foreach ($row in $ruFiles) { Assert-Ru1File $ruSource $row; Assert-Ru1File $tpRoot $row }
    $actual=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $tpRoot 'downloads'),(Join-Path $tpRoot 'schema') -File -Recurse -Force)
    if ($actual.Count -ne 9) { throw 'RU1 destination file count' }
    foreach ($item in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $tpRoot 'downloads'),(Join-Path $tpRoot 'schema') -Recurse -Force) { Assert-TpOrdinary $item.FullName }
    $bytes=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false).GetBytes((ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($ruFiles) -Depth 3 -Compress) + "`n")
    if ($bytes.Length -gt 1MB) { throw 'RU1 receipt limit' }
    $stream=[IO.File]::Open($receipt,[IO.FileMode]::CreateNew,[IO.FileAccess]::Write,[IO.FileShare]::None)
    try { $stream.Write($bytes) } finally { $stream.Dispose() }
    Assert-TpHash $receipt $bytes.Length ([Convert]::ToHexString([Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::HashData($bytes)))
    'RU1 nine original files copied and verified; independent phase acceptance still required'
}

If it cannot be acquired, leave the event uncontinued, end the debug-event operation and make the operation host exit so `DebugSetProcessKillOnExit(TRUE)` applies; never call `TerminateProcess` through an event handle whose termination right is unproved and never reopen a process at cleanup time.

Before any create event is continued, require non-null image/process/thread handles; obtain the normalized final DOS path and `FILE_ID_INFO` from the event `hFile`; hash bytes through that exact open image handle; and compare path, volume/file ID and SHA-256 with one of the two prelaunch entries. Each root event must match its returned `PROCESS_INFORMATION.dwProcessId` and exact `ollama.exe`; all child events may be only exact `ollama.exe` or `llama-server.exe` in the inherited debug chain. A null/inaccessible handle, failed control acquisition/hash/identity check, conflicting/reused PID, root mismatch or third executable latches fault before user-mode continuation. Executable permission is image-handle based; neither a later path reopen, PID/name, trace nor disappearance grants it.

The complete event switch has exact ownership and continuation rules. The debugger closes only non-null `CREATE_PROCESS_DEBUG_EVENT.hFile` and `LOAD_DLL_DEBUG_EVENT.hFile`, exactly once and before continuation; it never reads DLL/debug-string contents. Windows owns and closes debug-event process/thread handles after the corresponding continued exit; the debugger never closes or treats them as control handles. Explicit root and child control handles remain owned until final proof and close exactly once. Create/exit thread, unload-DLL and output-debug-string events record only bounded type/count metadata. Exactly one initial `EXCEPTION_BREAKPOINT` per authorized process is continued with `DBG_CONTINUE`; other first-chance exceptions use `DBG_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED`; any second-chance exception latches fault and uses `DBG_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED`. Normal nonexception events use `DBG_CONTINUE`. `RIP_EVENT`, unknown code and any API/continuation failure latch fault. Every continued event is continued exactly once by the event thread; an event deliberately left pending for fail-closed host exit is recorded as such and is never double-continued.

Use a 10-second first-event bound, 120-second per-image-validation bound, existing 180-second readiness bound and whole-operation/cleanup cutoffs. Cap the authorized process ledger at 64 records and the event loop at 8,192 events. The event thread records continued exit events; final drain additionally requires every retained control handle to be signaled. On ordinary stop or fault with usable controls, request termination only through the retained root/child `PROCESS_TERMINATE` handles, continue and drain eligible pending events, and wait boundedly for both exit-event and signaled-handle proof. On the fail-closed uncontinued-event path, return from the event thread and exit the operation host; do not attempt an under-rights termination. The main thread owns a bounded join. If the event thread misses it, the outside coordinator may terminate only its retained exact operation-host process handle; `DebugSetProcessKillOnExit(TRUE)` then covers the debuggees. No cleanup ownership is discovered or promoted by PID/name/path/listener, and absent current processes cannot repair an uncertain ledger.

internal sealed class ImageIdentity {

    internal static ImageIdentity Read(IntPtr handle,Action check) {
        check();
        var name=new StringBuilder(32768);
        uint length=Native.GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(handle,name,(uint)name.Capacity,0);
        Native.Require(length>0 && length<name.Capacity,"image-path");
        string path=name.ToString();
        Native.Require(path.StartsWith(@"\\?\") && path.Length>6 && path[5]==':',"image-dos-path");
        path=path.Substring(4);
        Native.FileId id; long size,position;
        Native.Require(Native.GetFileInformationByHandleEx(handle,18,out id,24),"image-file-id");
        Native.Require(Native.GetFileSizeEx(handle,out size) && size>0 && size<=1953507607,"image-size");
        Native.Require(Native.SetFilePointerEx(handle,0,out position,0) && position==0,"image-seek");
        using(var hash=IncrementalHash.CreateHash(HashAlgorithmName.SHA256)) {
            byte[] buffer=new byte[65536]; long total=0;
            while(total<size) {
                check(); uint got;
                Native.Require(Native.ReadFile(handle,buffer,(uint)Math.Min(buffer.Length,size-total),out got,IntPtr.Zero) && got>0,"image-read");
                hash.AppendData(buffer,0,(int)got); total+=got;
            }
            check();
            return new ImageIdentity {Path=path,Bytes=size,Id=id.Volume.ToString("X16")+":"+id.Low.ToString("X16")+id.High.ToString("X16"),
                Hash=Convert.ToHexString(hash.GetHashAndReset()).ToLowerInvariant()};
        }
    }
    internal bool Same(ImageIdentity other) {
        return other!=null && String.Equals(Path,other.Path,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
            Id==other.Id && Hash==other.Hash && Bytes==other.Bytes;

            Native.Require(server!=null && Native.WaitForSingleObject(server.Control,0)==258,"server-live");

                if(targetPort && listens) Native.Require(fields[1]=="127.0.0.1:11434" && pid==server.Pid,"server-listener");

                if(targetPort) listener=true;
                if(record==null) {
                    Native.Require(!controls.Any(p=>p.Pid==pid),"control-listener");
                    continue;
                }
                Native.Require(record.Authorized && Native.WaitForSingleObject(record.Control,0)==258,"listener-retained-owner");

                else {

                    Native.Require(record!=pull && record.Image!=null && runnerImage.Same(record.Image) &&
                        fields[1].StartsWith("127.0.0.1:",StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
                        Int32.TryParse(fields[1].Substring(10),out port) && port>=49152 && port<=65534,"runner-listener");
                }
            }
            foreach(string name in new[]{"ollama","llama-server"}) foreach(Process observed in Process.GetProcessesByName(name)) {
                using(observed) Native.Require(processes.Any(p=>p.Pid==(uint)observed.Id && Native.WaitForSingleObject(p.Control,0)==258),"unknown-runtime-process");
            }
            Native.Require(fault.Length==0&&!stop&&Now<LiveEnd,"inspection-publish");
            lastSocketCheck=Now;
            return listener;
        }

    public string ReadReceipt(string outputName,string expectedHash="") {

            Native.Require(receiptOutputs.Contains(path),"receipt-path");
            Native.Require(new FileInfo(path).Length<=65536,"receipt-size");
            byte[] bytes=File.ReadAllBytes(path);
            Native.Require(bytes.Length<=65536,"receipt-read-size");
            if(expectedHash.Length!=0) Native.Require(bytes.Length==741 &&
                Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(bytes)).ToLowerInvariant()==expectedHash,"manifest-original-bytes");
            string result=new UTF8Encoding(false,true).GetString(bytes);
            Native.Require(fault.Length==0&&!stop&&Now<LiveEnd,"receipt-publish");
            return result;
        }

    public bool StopAndJoin() {

        }

        joined=eventThread.Join(milliseconds);
        lock(sync) {
            if(!joined) {fatal=true;Fault("debug-join");}
            return joined && !fatal && fault.Length==0 && phase=="Stopped" && queueEmpty && !pendingImage &&
                processes.All(p=>p.ExitContinued&&Native.WaitForSingleObject(p.Control,0)==0) &&

    }

                string[] fields=line.Split((char[])null,StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                if(fields.Length==0||fields[0]!="TCP") continue;
                Native.Require(fields.Length==5,"terminal-netstat-row");
                uint pid;Native.Require(UInt32.TryParse(fields[4],out pid),"terminal-netstat-pid");

            }
            TerminalReady();
            return processes.Concat(controls).Select(p=>p.Pid).ToArray();
        }
    }

                exceptions=exceptions.OrderBy(p=>p.Key).Select(p=>new {code=p.Key,count=p.Value}),
                processes=processes.Select(p=>new {pid=p.Pid,role=p.Role,ack=p.Ack,authorized=p.Authorized,

                    path=p.Image==null?null:p.Image.Path,fileId=p.Image==null?null:p.Image.Id,
                    sha256=p.Image==null?null:p.Image.Hash,bytes=p.Image==null?0:p.Image.Bytes,exit=p.ExitContinued,exitCode=p.ExitCode,
                    waitResult=Native.WaitForSingleObject(p.Control,0),signaled=Native.WaitForSingleObject(p.Control,0)==0,
                    terminationAttempted=p.TerminationSent,terminationSucceeded=p.TerminationSucceeded,
                    terminationRaced=p.TerminationRaced,terminationError=p.TerminationError}),
                controls=controls.Select(p=>new {pid=p.Pid,role=p.Role,exitCode=p.ExitCode,
                    waitResult=Native.WaitForSingleObject(p.Control,0),signaled=Native.WaitForSingleObject(p.Control,0)==0,
                    terminationAttempted=p.TerminationSent,terminationSucceeded=p.TerminationSucceeded,
                    terminationRaced=p.TerminationRaced,terminationError=p.TerminationError})

    }
    public void Finish() {
        lock(sync) {
            TerminalReady();Native.Require(terminalInspected,"dispose-before-independent-proof");
            Native.Require(processes.All(p=>Native.WaitForSingleObject(p.Control,0)==0)&&controls.All(p=>Native.WaitForSingleObject(p.Control,0)==0),"dispose-live");
            foreach(var p in processes.Concat(controls)) {Native.Close(ref p.InitialThread);Native.Close(ref p.Control);}

            pins.Clear();disposed=true;
        }
    }

            cleanupEnd=$m202CleanupEnd.ToString('O')
            native=$m202Owner.Snapshot()|ConvertFrom-Json
        }
        $encoded=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes(($report|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30 -Compress))
        if ($encoded.Length -gt 1044480) { $encoded=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes('{"outcome":"failed","stage":"receipt-overflow"}');$m202Accepted=$false }
        $stream=[IO.File]::Open((Join-Path $m202Receipt 'debug-control.json'),[IO.FileMode]::CreateNew,[IO.FileAccess]::Write,[IO.FileShare]::None)
        try { $stream.Write($encoded,0,$encoded.Length);$stream.Flush($true) } finally { $stream.Dispose() }
        if ($m202Accepted -and $m202StopVerified -and $m202TerminalVerified) { $m202Owner.Finish() }
        if ($m202Owner.Fatal) { [Environment]::Exit(2) }
    }
}
if (-not $m202Accepted -or -not $m202StopVerified) { exit 2 }
exit 0
```

Only the fixed terminal netstat leaf is allowed in that phase; no API/root/model action is admitted. Its successful proof enters the closed receipt before Finish releases handles. A failure before retry-03 exists preserves its bounded diagnostic in memory and fixed summary only; no output directory is created merely to log that failed admission. A sanitized fixed stage and exception type replace raw exception text; compiler/runtime validity is still unproved. Preserve every existing or new output; no second start/pull or deletion follows.

| I2 | Corrupt/duplicate/missing ID, altered text under same version, stale corpus reference, incompatible version | Visible integrity failure; no usable replacement snapshot, partial vector publication, old-vector reuse, or canonical rewrite. An authorized new version requires a new reviewed input, not automatic refresh. | Slice A/B critical reviewer |
| I3 | Unknown/ambiguous rule mapping, unavailable evidence, synthetic URL/selector/page/sibling canaries | Mapping failure before embedding when invalid; allowlisted query only for a valid selected Finding; no invented measured fact or evidence-completeness conclusion. | Slice A critical reviewer |
| I4 | Startup, mode selection, scan; then first/later explicit retrieval | No model check, embedding or MemoryVectorStore construction at startup/selection/scan. First actual retrieval builds once; compatible later requests only embed their query; restart/material incompatibility requires a fresh build. | Slice B critical reviewer |
| I5 | Tag/digest drift, wrong returned model/count/dimension, zero/non-finite vector, oversize input, redirect/off-loopback target | Reject without truncation, retry, fallback, hosted call, mixed vectors or success provenance; bounded content-safe error. Exact policy must establish what digest the vector evidence represents. | Slice B critical reviewer |
| I6 | More than three eligible passages and equal scores spanning rank three; shuffled insertion order | Only exact rule/SC filtering, exact cosine, deterministic passage-ID tie ordering before cutoff, at most three canonical references; role/gold/source authority does not affect order. | Slice A/B critical reviewer |
| I7 | Two selected Findings, simultaneous scan/read/retrieval, duplicate action | One reservation before asynchronous work; no second user operation or queued attempt; only the intended Finding can change, with completed scan/provider context and siblings preserved. | Slice C critical reviewer |
| I8 | Failed nested write, shutdown/deadline, late embedding response, uncertain cleanup, restart after interrupted action | Last valid aggregate remains authoritative; parent stays completed; no unsaved durable success, automatic resume, new retry lineage or late publication; affected action fails within reviewed semantics. | Slice C critical reviewer |
| I9 | Real smoke versus test doubles/published metadata | All 16 canonical passages plus the frozen one-Finding query use real local embeddings and the production exact-search/service/publication path; app/UI active, no OOM/storage exhaustion/unusable UI; no quality or support claim. | Final critical reviewer |

## Plan of Work

### Common execution contract

After owner authorization, primary reconciles HEAD, index, dirty paths, protected-file fingerprints, runtime/tool pins, relevant ignored output inventories and any active lease before advancing. Read-only discovery may proceed with unresolved literals; worker preflight/writes cannot pass the literal/command barriers. Each application slice's packet names its exact callables, expected result, accepted test boundary, responsibility/dependency/refactor contract, commands, side effects and stop conditions. The path envelopes below are planned placements, not blanket leases; freeze exact files before preflight and project them unchanged into each write lease.

For each behavioral slice, keep a separate `test_worker` and `code_worker`. Preflight is read-only with no lease. Accept `EXISTING_AND_COVERED` evidence without writing, characterize `EXISTING_BUT_UNCOVERED`, isolate a confirmed `PARTIAL` gap, use Red for `MISSING`/`REGRESSION`, and stop on `UNKNOWN`/`CONFLICTING`. A genuinely absent agreed callable may use only ADR-0024's first-module Red exception: verified environment and complete behavioral tests, precise missing-callable failure, no stub, and an honest record that assertions did not execute. Green executes all accepted tests unchanged and passes independent strict TypeScript.

Every write turn gets a fresh complete Packet v2 and primary-opened/closed guard lease; require a fresh `closed-compliant` receipt, inspect the real diff and results, and forbid accepted tests during Green. Workers never change Git state or primary-owned documentation. Primary writes this plan, literal/evaluation notes, developer instructions and status only between leases. Ignored runtime/cache outputs are not covered by the guard and need explicit effects/inventories/cleanup checks, never ignored `--allow-file` scopes.

Per behavioral slice: one preflight, one coherent Red/characterization, one Green with optional same-turn behavior-preserving Refactor, at most one same-contract correction per role (attempt 2 naming its terminal parent), and one review correction loop. Stop after the same decisive failure twice, two no-diff write handoffs, exhausted budget or changed binding field. Every post-Green handoff records actual cohesion as `RETAINED`, `REFACTORED`, or `RECONCILE`; setup/pre-Green uses `None`. Material mixed responsibility must be fixed or reconciled before acceptance, not deferred because tests pass. No optional review panel or full-suite rerun per assertion.

### Setup — minimum retrieval dependencies

After accepted L1–L5 policies, both research checkpoints, the existing L6 metadata-prefilter method/receipts and separate installation approval, one `code_worker` setup lease may change only `package.json` and `package-lock.json` to add the exact reviewed retrieval dependencies. L6's fresh app/UI-active resource observations remain due before actual model use, not dependency setup. TDD: **Not applicable**, because manifest/lock setup adds no production behavior. Production responsibility: **None — no application-source responsibility changes**. Validate exact pins, import surfaces, script-suppressed restore, unchanged unrelated dependency pins, strict typecheck, and expected generated-output inventory. L1 now freezes both initial lock-generation and later clean-restore commands; do not improvise an upgrade after a failing install. A fresh S0 `milestone_reviewer` checks the setup and decisive structural evidence. Primary updates developer instructions afterward. No model pull is a package lifecycle script.

### Slice A — canonical catalog and selected-Finding query/result contract

One cohesive outcome: fixed catalog input plus one validated Finding yields a canonical passage view and privacy-safe retrieval request, with bounded integrity/mapping failures and an application-owned ranked-result shape. Preflight inspects M2-01 data, current domain validators and any already-created retrieval source/tests. Authority: L2–L5; `REQ-CORP-001`, `003`, `005`–`007`; `REQ-RETR-001`, `005`, `006`; ADR-0013/0019/0022. Risk **S3**: corpus identity and data minimization.

Planned production placements under `src/server/retrieval/`: `corpus-catalog.ts` for fixed snapshot loading/validation; `finding-query.ts` for mapping and allowlisted semantic projection; `retrieval-contract.ts` for only the current retrieval types/result validator. Separate catalog I/O from query policy; do not add a generic loader or schema platform. Dependency direction: retrieval contracts/query consume the domain's current Finding type and fixed corpus; domain types never depend on Ollama, LangChain or service I/O. L5 must settle any shared shape first; this slice does not enable terminal aggregate mutation.

Test ownership: planned `tests/retrieval-contract.test.ts`, with a task-specific test helper only if current fixture construction warrants it. Production workers may locally extract one cohesive validator within the frozen retrieval path list if that exact permission is recorded before the lease; no generic `utils` or unrelated domain refactor. Other source, corpus, gold, dependencies, fixtures and documentation are forbidden. Focused command C-A and strict check must prove I2/I3/I6's contract portions, detachment, permitted source metadata, and failure without altering input. Primary accepts evidence `M202-A-*`; fresh S3 review must pass before B.

- ollama-http.ts exports OllamaRequest = {kind:'version'|'tags'|'show'|'ps'} | {kind:'embed',input:string}, OllamaRequester = (request:OllamaRequest,signal:AbortSignal)=>Promise<unknown>, and requestOllama(request,signal,requestImplementation?) using native node:http.request by default. A refused connection or absent metadata/model is missing-prerequisite; other transport/status failure is embedding-failed; malformed successful metadata is model-identity and malformed successful embedding content is embedding-response. - ollama-embedding.ts exports beginOllamaEmbedding(signal:AbortSignal,request?:OllamaRequester):Promise<OllamaEmbeddingSession>. A session provides embedDocument(text:string):Promise<readonly number[]>, embedQuery(text:string):Promise<readonly number[]> and finish():Promise<void>. It follows L3 exactly: version/tags/show/ps admission, first necessary singleton input followed immediately by ps when previously unloaded, and tags/show/ps at finish. It never synthesizes an input or re-embeds documents on a compatible unloaded-model cache hit. It checks active signal/session state around every await; finished/failed sessions cannot dispatch more work. Model/vector validation is pure in ollama-model.ts; its local function names are not a test contract.

## Idempotence and Recovery

Retain M2-02 downloads and disposable verification output through task completion, reusing verified inputs instead of repeated acquisition. Treat the existing external `Tools/EmbeddingVerification/m202-tp3-*` attempt directories as task-temporary storage without moving them and invalidating pinned paths. Completion cleanup must identify exact disposable children, preserve necessary verification evidence, and retain permanent developer runtime/model/tokenizer inputs and pre-existing resources. This retention direction authorizes no deletion or relocation during SC1.

Read-only status, hash, strict and pure-test checks are safe to repeat under the same environment. A changed fingerprint invalidates dependent evidence, not unrelated historical results. Do not assume the planning SHA is the execution SHA; reconcile intentional plan commits before sealing a fresh baseline. Never alter a lease's baseline or replay a terminal receipt as fresh verification.

Only one writer/lease and one application operation may run in this worktree at a time. If a worker stops unexpectedly, primary first ends the turn, closes/inspects its exact lease, records partial outcomes and reconciles the tree. No reset, stash, checkout, force-close, ignore bypass, or overwritten guard JSON is a recovery mechanism. Unexpected overlapping edits are preserved and require direction if they cannot be isolated.

Keep incomplete vector builds private until complete validation, discard failed/incompatible in-memory vectors and expose failure under the frozen policy. This is not a persistent index recovery system. No startup model request, automatic pull, resume or retry may be used to repair state. A nested publication failure leaves the last valid run bytes authoritative and the parent completed; no failed-run rewrite or unsaved success is allowed. The exact treatment of an interrupted selected action must already be frozen in L5.

Before generated-output or synthetic-run cleanup, stop only task-owned service/driver/browser work, verify normal closure, resolve the exact absolute child paths, inspect ordinary topology/inventory/identity and preserve pre-existing resources. Use one-shell PowerShell literal paths. Never target a workspace root, `data/runs`, corpus, global cache or developer model store with recursive removal. A changed or uncertain target remains for inspection; do not claim successful cleanup. Report removed material and recoverability. Retain completed M2-01 artifacts and notices; no source re-acquisition is part of recovery.
